purpose: Independent focused cross-check of the fourteen proposed reference relationships before registration. Existing literature selection reused; no parallel E-utilities calls.
scope: An independently authored anatomical source pair for reference membership does not establish original experimental observations, presence in a specific specimen, a contour or a point.

sourcesDirectlyRead.locator: PDF p.155, The Temporal Fossa: anterior wall, lateral boundary and floor
Printed/PDF p.11, Temporal fossa: Boundaries and Floor

rows.requiredRestriction: Accept whole fossa plus boundaries. Gray includes zygomatic in its floor wording, CBS separates four-bone floor and zygomatic anterior boundary; retain discrepancy, never label five bones as one agreed floor definition.

rows.requiredRestriction: Accept only the three-bone membership. NBK513269 later boundary prose is not accepted here (temporalis lateral boundary and sphenoid/palatine-process wording); do not copy extra details.

sourcesDirectlyRead.locator: PDF p.157, Pterygomaxillary fissure and The Pterygopalatine Fossa

Abstract, Objective; Results: variable bony wall, not model measurements

rows.requiredRestriction: CBS and Herzallah abstract explicitly name palatine sphenoidal process and sphenoid vaginal process. Variable identification/walls in cadavers do not establish this model.

sourcesDirectlyRead.locator: PDF p.162, The Orbits: paragraph beginning The base of the orbit
Printed/PDF p.7, Orbital openings: four margins; Bony nasal aperture: Boundaries

rows.requiredRestriction: Medial entrance rim is frontal + frontal process of maxilla; lacrimal/ethmoid/sphenoid medial wall must not be imported.

sourcesDirectlyRead.locator: PDF p.122, The Frontal Process: last part; PDF p.126, Lacrimal orbital surface
Anatomy and Physiology: Lacrimal Sac and Duct; Endoscopic Nasal Anatomy, first paragraph

rows.requiredRestriction: Lacrimal sac fossa is frontal process maxilla + lacrimal bone. Neither local lacrimal groove alone equals the whole fossa; no size accepted.
